scope: Unprompted pretrained phoneme consistency on97 original training WAVs from the frozen38-triplet acoustic review queue; no wake training, automatic relabeling or quality advancement.
hypothesis: Check whether spectral-distance inversions in the frozen queue also appear under an independent learned phoneme readout. Agreement may prioritize later human review; disagreement may reflect metric/style differences or recognizer error. Neither outcome certifies pronunciation.

model.use: Independent phoneme consistency diagnostic only; no wake model acceptance

inference: CPU float32,2 intra-op/1 inter-op threads,eval/inference mode,seed0,deterministic algorithms. Original full16k mono PCM16 decoded tofloat32/32768. Use pinned extractor/model locally only, no expected text/lexicon/ASR prompt, no crop/resample/gain/tempo augmentation. Require no missing or mismatched pretrained model tensors. One inference per source; retain all frame logits and greedy CTC IDs/phones. Collapse consecutive argmax IDs before removing blank0; do not remove nonblank special tokens.
analysis: Use the existing38 spectral-selected triplets without re-ranking sources. Normalize token Levenshtein distance by max sequence length for positive and negative comparisons; compare order by exact integer cross-products. Empty predictions are an explicit category. Keep ties, all original source intentions, both spectral inversion/noninversion groups and different-intent sources with identical predicted strings. No expected dictionary-phone strings or inference confidence threshold.
advance_action: None. No new training, sample filtering or quality/model promotion follows automatically. The queue is selected from reused training data, not an independent acceptance set. Human pronunciation/reference review is still required.
limits: This learned phoneme model was already observed to make errors on these synthesizers. Predictions, edit-distance order and cross-intent predicted-string collisions are not verified pronunciation, actual waveform collisions, human wake recall or true phone endpoint labels. The deliberately selected correlated97 sources/38 triplets cannot rank TTS engine quality or estimate corpus-wide label errors. No labels, splits or checkpoints change. No validation/final scoring, API keys, network inference, speaker, microphone, board/USB, firmware/OTA, production board, original PCM speed or single I2S/AEC/AGC/FIFO modification. Full Hi ESP acoustic recognition/FAR/latency,P4 resources and long-call/reconnect stability remain unproven.
